subject: Prepay activation gate and tax evidence orchestration
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@brightlane.co>, Tom Gallagher <tom.g@brightlane.co>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-22T09:12:00Z
Subject: Prepay activation gate and tax evidence orchestration

Hi Elena / Tom,

Thanks again for committing to the annual prepay. To keep the activation smooth on our side we need to align on three operational items before we issue the first invoice:

- AP contact and remit details (bank wiring vs ACH).
- VAT/tax evidence we should attach to the invoice (country-by-country).
- Milestone trigger windows for scheduled drawdowns (we propose quarterly sweeps with optional monthly top-ups).

I've attached an initial checklist and a VAT evidence template to make this quick. Can you confirm the AP contact and whether Brightlane requires netting the prepay against monthly usage or prefers separate remittance entries?

Next steps I suggest: once AP details are confirmed we send a DocuSign for the prepay schedule and kick off the first invoice for the deposit.

Attachments: [prepay_activation_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)], [vat_evidence_template.pdf (pdf)]

Thanks,
Priyom
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@brightlane.co>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Gallagher <tom.g@brightlane.co>, accounts-payable@brightlane.co, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-22T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Prepay activation gate and tax evidence orchestration

Hi Priyom,

Appreciate the clear checklist. AP is accounts-payable@brightlane.co (I included the mailbox). For wires, routing is to Brightlane Inc - JP Morgan - Account 4421-78-01 - Swift JPMBUS33. We prefer a single invoice for the deposit, then monthly usage can be netted as a credit memo against that prepay.

VAT: we can provide VAT registration certificates for the EU entities and a tax residency letter for the US entity. Expect our finance lead Tom to confirm sequencing.

Can you share an example invoice showing the deposit + monthly credit netting? Also confirm whether you need VAT certificates as scanned PDFs or formal government extracts.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Director, Strategic Ops
Brightlane
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@brightlane.co>, accounts-payable@brightlane.co
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-22T13:26:00Z
Subject: Re: Prepay activation gate and tax evidence orchestration

Elena / AP team,

Thanks — that works. Attached is a sample invoice layout and a revised activation schedule that reflects the quarterly sweep + optional monthly netting row you requested. Key points:

- Initial deposit invoice (Invoice 0001) issued upon DocuSign execution.
- Quarterly sweep windows: 1 Apr, 1 Jul, 1 Oct, 1 Jan (each window allows a 5-business-day drawdown period).
- Optional monthly netting: we will issue monthly usage statements; if Brightlane elects to net, we post a credit memo reducing the next drawdown invoice.
- VAT handling: for EU entities we will require VAT certs (PDF scans of the registration certificate). For the US entity the tax residency letter is sufficient.

Attachments: [prepay_activation_schedule_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)], [sample_deposit_invoice.pdf (pdf)]

If AP confirms wire details above, Marcus will provide wire instructions and the DocuSign link.

Priyom
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@brightlane.co>, accounts-payable@brightlane.co
Date: 2028-03-23T08:41:00Z
Subject: VAT evidence routing and EU tax exceptions

Folks,

Quick notes from the tax team on evidence collection:

- EU VAT: we need either the national VAT registration certificate (PDF) or a GOV extract link plus a signed attestation on company letterhead. The EU entities must match the invoiced legal entity exactly.
- UK VAT: if Brightlane is registered in the UK, we require the VRN plus a scanned certificate; HMRC portal screenshots are acceptable if they include entity name and VRN.
- US: tax residency letter + W-8/W-9 as applicable.

If Elena can drop the certs into the shared Drive folder (link below) we will attach them to the invoice packet and flag any missing jurisdictions before billing.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B-example-prepay-onboarding

Kimberly Park
Tax Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Tom Gallagher <tom.g@brightlane.co>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, accounts-payable@brightlane.co
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@brightlane.co>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-23T14:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Prepay activation gate and tax evidence orchestration

Thanks Priyom — we can provide the VAT certs and tax letter this week. One operational ask from AP: instead of a single large deposit line, can Redwood show the deposit as three tranche lines on the invoice (Apr/Jul/Oct) with the total due now but split for accounting visibility? Functionally we want a single payment but three ledger rows so our finance system maps the prepay across Q2/Q3/Q4 budgets.

Example in practice: Invoice 0001 - Deposit (Tranche 1 of 3) 50,000; Tranche 2 of 3 50,000; Tranche 3 of 3 50,000 - Total 150,000. Payment made once; your backend should allocate it to the three rows. Is that something Redwood can support?

Tom
Head of Finance Operations
Brightlane
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: accounts-payable@brightlane.co, Tom Gallagher <tom.g@brightlane.co>, Elena Ruiz <elena@brightlane.co>
